systems.system: sistema informático do registo de nascimento
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: not stated; named only as the computer system whose data the identity card draws on

systems.system: interoperabilidade entre os sistemas do registo de nascimento e do Bilhete de Identidade
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: not stated; the minister says on 1 July 2026 that the card results from integrating the data in the birth registration, through interoperability between the two computer systems

systems.system: Plano de Universalização do Bilhete de Identidade
systems.country_label: Plano de Universalização do Bilhete de Identidade
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: printing posts in the capitals of all 21 provinces, five in Luanda; second phase to issue the card at birth in maternities and hospitals with civil registration services; registration and issuance also at diplomatic missions and consular posts

systems.system: brigadas móveis equipadas com sistemas de impressão
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos, with the Ministério da Administração do Território
systems.tiers: remote localities without permanent justice services; already registering and issuing cards locally in Moxico-Leste

note: The minister describes identity-card printing, mobile brigades and the card's dependence on the birth registration system; the report does not say where or how the birth record itself is made, so the birth registration system is unclassified and gives no fact.
